tooltips.webhookVerifyToken: Shared secret used during Meta's `hub.verify_token` webhook verification handshake. Auto-generated on first 'Configure Meta Webhook' run. Must match the Verify Token you paste into the Meta App Dashboard → Products → Instagram → Webhooks. The configure action pushes this value to every ChatwootPlatform.

messages.confirmConfigureMetaInstagramWebhook: This will generate (if needed) a webhook Verify Token, sync it to every ChatwootPlatform, and show you the Callback URL + Verify Token to paste into the Meta App Dashboard → Products → Instagram → Webhooks. Proceed?
messages.metaWebhookConfigured: Verify Token is in sync with Chatwoot. Paste the values below into the Meta App Dashboard to finish setup.
messages.metaWebhookConfiguredWithNewToken: A new Verify Token was generated and synced to Chatwoot. Paste the values below into the Meta App Dashboard to finish setup.
messages.metaWebhookConfiguredChatwootFailed: Verify Token is set locally, but some ChatwootPlatforms failed to accept it. See details below.
